abstract:
Quantum field theory describes particles that can be created and destroyed, and this trail builds it inside one real geometric algebra. [[t]] The tower's fermionic modes do not by themselves sit anywhere in spacetime. [[c:field-theory.ground-does-not-attach-modes]] With the spacetime volume element as the field's imaginary unit, second quantisation gives a local field with the standard observables. [[c:field-theory.second-quantisation]]

The walk adds mass, the photon and gravity's source, then adopts one premise, an indefinite inner product for gauge fields. [[t]] Under it the first and second quantum corrections of electrodynamics and the running of the force strengths come out with the textbook values. [[c:synthesis.krein-form-premise-indefinite-inner-product-for-gauge-fields]] The triangle anomaly cancels within each generation. [[c:synthesis.triangle-anomaly-in-the-spacetime-algebra-is-the-pseudoscalar-part-of-the-field-square-and-cancels-per-generation]] The trail ends with the gauge structure of the gluons and weak bosons, the tie between spin and statistics, and what is still open. [[t]]
introduction: The walk first attaches the modes to spacetime, sorts out the imaginary units and quantises the free fields. [[t]] It then adopts one premise and follows the loops of electrodynamics, the anomaly and the gauge fields of the strong and weak forces. [[t]] It ends with spin and statistics, and with the questions the field theory leaves open. [[t]]
i:quantum-fields: Each step below adds one piece to a quantum field theory written entirely in one real algebra. [[t]]
t:^>field-theory.ground-does-not-attach-:
The series' tower stacks extra planes on top of the algebra of spacetime, and each plane carries one fermionic quantum mode. [[c:field-theory.imported-tower-limit]] But the spacetime symmetries, the translations, rotations and boosts, commute with every mode operator, so a field built from the modes $a_j$, \[ \psi(x) = \sum_j u_j(x)\,a_j , \] on which translations act covariantly can only have constant mode functions $u_j$. [[c:field-theory.ground-does-not-attach-modes]]

The obstruction is that each floor of the tower is finite, and a group like the boosts, which never closes up on itself, has no nontrivial quantum action on a finite floor. [[c:field-theory.ground-does-not-attach-modes]]
t:field-theory.ground-does-not-attach-mo:
Something else must supply the link between modes and spacetime. [[t]] It comes from the conformal spinor space $\CS$ (twistor space), which supplies positive-energy particle states with a conformal-group action, while the Penrose transform turns them into waves in spacetime. [[c:field-theory.twistor-attachment]]

In the oscillator model the helicity-$s$ states have energies and multiplicities \[ |s| + 1 + n , \qquad (n+1)(n + 2|s| + 1) \] so the tower's floors are energy cut-offs, not regions of space. [[c:field-theory.twistor-attachment]] The standard link between spin and statistics holds: a lift is local exactly when $2s$ is odd, and the series' fermions pass. [[c:field-theory.twistor-attachment]]
t:field-theory.twistor-attachment>field-:
Quantum theory needs a square root of minus one, and this attachment brings in two candidates that must be kept apart. [[t]] The conformal spinors' unit is the conformal volume element $I_6$, while a massless field's unit is the spacetime volume element $I_4$, and they differ by the bivector $E$ of the added conformal plane: \[ I_6 = I_4 E , \qquad E = e_+ e_- , \qquad E^2 = 1 \] [[c:field-theory.where-each-lives]]

On the spinors at a point, $I_6 = +I_4$ on one chiral doublet and $-I_4$ on the other. [[c:field-theory.where-each-lives]] A mass term anticommutes with $I_4$, which the next steps put to use. [[c:field-theory.where-each-lives]]
t:field-theory.where-each-lives>field-th:
With the field's unit fixed as $I_4$, fields valued in the spacetime algebra, with tower planes as modes, can be quantised inside one algebra. [[c:field-theory.second-quantisation]] The projector onto the solutions with null momentum $k$ is \[ \Lambda(k) = \frac{k\gamma_0}{2k_0} \] and the field's anticommutator has no tower part, so the field is local and its observables are the standard second-quantised ones. [[c:field-theory.second-quantisation]]

The price of this unit is that a field's two chiralities enter differently, the right-handed part directly and the left-handed part conjugated. [[c:field-theory.second-quantisation]] Hestenes' choice of unit avoids the split but depends on a chosen frame. [[c:field-theory.second-quantisation]]
t:field-theory.second-quantisation>field:
One binary choice from the series' derivation of particle physics remains: an orientation that tells particles from antiparticles. [[c:field-theory.orientation-relocated]] Fixing the field's unit as $I_4$ does not remove it, because left multiplication by $e_+$ swaps the two halves $T$ and $T'$ of the conformal spinor space while commuting with $I_4$ and with Lorentz rotors. [[c:field-theory.orientation-relocated]]

The halves are told apart only by the conformal spinors' own unit $J$, right multiplication by $I_6$: on the momentum doublet $J = +I_4$ in $T$ and $J = -I_4$ in $T'$. [[c:field-theory.orientation-relocated]] The algebra fixes $J$ only up to sign, so the orientation becomes the relative sign of the two units. [[c:field-theory.orientation-relocated]]
t:field-theory.orientation-relocated>fie:
Mass is the next ingredient, and it involves both chiralities at once. [[t]] For a right factor $N$ that anticommutes with Hestenes' unit, the pairing \[ B_N(\psi, \phi) = \proj(\tilde\psi\phi N) \] is the Lorentz-invariant two-component (epsilon) pairing, and a massive Dirac wave couples a part $\chi$ to a part $\eta$ of opposite $I_4$-charge with mass density $2B(\chi, \eta)$. [[c:field-theory.mass]]

The mass breaks the common $I_4$ phase rotation, which is axial, and $I_4$ stays the field algebra's unit rather than the complex structure of the massive equation. [[c:field-theory.mass]] That equation still needs one geometric datum beyond the field, in effect a rest-frame direction. [[c:field-theory.imported-one-datum-massive-law]]
t:field-theory.mass>field-theory.fock-sp:
Mass alone gives free particles; a force carried across distance needs a boson, such as the photon, and bosons do not fit in the tower directly. [[t]] The exact commutation rule of bosons cannot be realised in any finite-dimensional algebra; it needs infinitely many states, as in the standard representation on polynomials. [[c:field-theory.imported-statistics-no-go-palatial-algebra]]

So the photon's states are polynomials with $I_4$ as the imaginary unit, and \[ a_m = \frac{\partial}{\partial z_m} , \qquad a_m^* = z_m \] satisfy the bosonic commutation relations exactly, one complex mode per photon momentum. [[c:field-theory.fock-space-maxwell-modes]] With this unit positive frequency is positive helicity for every massless field, so the photon field operator destroys one helicity and creates the other. [[c:field-theory.fock-space-maxwell-modes]]
t:field-theory.fock-space-maxwell-modes>:
The same tools let gravity's source be written as an operator rather than an average. [[t]] For a massive fermion built in the tower the mode occupations change, but the quasi-particle numbers and a charge built from the modes are conserved. [[c:field-theory.conserved-numbers-mass-block]]

If the Newtonian pull is built from such conserved numbers $N_i$, \[ H_N = -G\sum_{i<j}\frac{M_iM_jN_iN_j}{r_{ij}} , \] two masses each held in a superposition of two places pick up exactly the registered entangling phase, with its sign. [[c:field-theory.operator-newtonian-coupling]] A mean-field version of gravity would entangle nothing; the registered prediction itself rests on its own stated premises, which this trail does not show. [[c:field-theory.operator-newtonian-coupling]]
t:field-theory.operator-newtonian-coupli:
Quantum corrections come from loops of virtual particles, and computing them in a way that treats space and time alike needs a photon description in which some unphysical states have negative or zero length. [[c:synthesis.krein-form-premise-indefinite-inner-product-for-gauge-fields]] The series' quantum spaces all have positive lengths, so it cannot use this bookkeeping as it stands. [[c:synthesis.krein-form-premise-indefinite-inner-product-for-gauge-fields]]

It therefore adopts a premise: gauge fields, their ghosts and their regulator fields carry one indefinite (Krein) inner product, the Gupta-Bleuler form $[a(u), a(w)^{\dagger}] = -u\cdot w$ on the polarisations, and only states of positive length survive once the unphysical ones cancel in groups of four. [[c:synthesis.krein-form-premise-indefinite-inner-product-for-gauge-fields]] It is taken as given, not derived, and it would be refuted by physical states of negative length or by physical amplitudes that depend on the gauge. [[c:synthesis.krein-form-premise-indefinite-inner-product-for-gauge-fields]]

With that premise in place, and with regulators imported in the Pauli-Villars form, some of negative weight, the first quantum corrections of electrodynamics come out of the spacetime algebra with the textbook values. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-qed-in-the-spacetime-algebra]]

The screening of charge by virtual pairs has coefficient $e^{2}/(12\pi^{2})$ per Dirac fermion, and the electron's extra magnetic moment is \[ F_{2}(0) = \frac{\alpha}{2\pi} , \] carried by the real bivector $\gamma^{\mu} \wedge q$ with no imaginary number in it. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-qed-in-the-spacetime-algebra]] The identity $Z_{1} = Z_{2}$, which keeps charge the same at every order, holds. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-qed-in-the-spacetime-algebra]]

One point is specific to the series: on massive lines the unit $I_4$ must stand outside the products, or charge conservation fails. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-qed-in-the-spacetime-algebra]]
t:synthesis.one-loop-qed-in-the-spacetim:
The same spin traces fix how the strengths of the three forces change with energy. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-running-coefficients-from-spacetime-algebra-spin-traces]] Each field's spin gives a weight, $\tfrac13$, $\tfrac23$ and $-\tfrac{11}{3}$ per unit index for scalars, Weyl spinors and vectors, once a standard heat-kernel formula is imported. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-running-coefficients-from-spacetime-algebra-spin-traces]]

The numbers of generations $n_{g}$ and of Higgs doublets $n_{h}$ are inputs, since the store has not settled either. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-running-coefficients-from-spacetime-algebra-spin-traces]] For the content the series derives under its slot hypothesis, three generations and one doublet give the standard coefficients $(\tfrac{41}{10}, -\tfrac{19}{6}, -7)$, and two doublets give $(\tfrac{21}{5}, -3, -7)$. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-running-coefficients-from-spacetime-algebra-spin-traces]] With three generations colour and weak isospin both weaken at high energy for every number of doublets up to $19$. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-running-coefficients-from-spacetime-algebra-spin-traces]]
t:synthesis.one-loop-running-coefficient:
Going beyond the first correction usually means letting the dimension of spacetime vary, and that raises the question of what happens to the field's unit. [[t]]

In four dimensions $i = I_4$ squares to $-1$, commutes with every bivector and anticommutes with every vector. [[c:synthesis.unit-i4-keeps-its-three-properties-only-in-dimension-zero-mod-four]] In the algebras $\Cl(1, D-1)$ all three properties hold together only when $D \equiv 0 \pmod 4$, that is in dimensions four, eight, twelve and so on. [[c:synthesis.unit-i4-keeps-its-three-properties-only-in-dimension-zero-mod-four]] In other dimensions the unit gives up either covariance under rotations that mix old and new directions or its anticommutation with vectors, the same split as the known difficulty with the chirality element in dimensional regularisation. [[c:synthesis.unit-i4-keeps-its-three-properties-only-in-dimension-zero-mod-four]]
t:synthesis.unit-i4-keeps-its-three-prop:
With one contraction rule the Clifford product continues to any dimension, and the second quantum correction of electrodynamics can be computed in dimensional regularisation, under the Krein premise. [[c:synthesis.two-loop-qed-in-the-spacetime-algebra-continued-in-dimension-gives-the-second-beta-coefficient]]

The vacuum polarisation of a massless Dirac fermion is transverse and independent of the gauge choice in every dimension, and its nested infinities cancel because $Z_{1} = Z_{2}$ holds integrand by integrand. [[c:synthesis.two-loop-qed-in-the-spacetime-algebra-continued-in-dimension-gives-the-second-beta-coefficient]] The result is the standard second coefficient $\beta_{1} = 4$ per fermion, \[ \mu\frac{d\alpha}{d\mu} = \frac{2\alpha^{2}}{3\pi} + \frac{\alpha^{3}}{2\pi^{2}} , \] with the $\overline{\mathrm{MS}}$ constant $16\zeta_{3} - 55/3$. [[c:synthesis.two-loop-qed-in-the-spacetime-algebra-continued-in-dimension-gives-the-second-beta-coefficient]]

The method of taming the infinities is borrowed, not the series' own, but the second-order rate does not depend on which standard method is used. [[c:synthesis.two-loop-qed-in-the-spacetime-algebra-continued-in-dimension-gives-the-second-beta-coefficient]]
t:synthesis.two-loop-qed-in-the-spacetim:
A running coupling is not yet an observation; a prediction needs a scattering rate. [[t]]

Through LSZ reduction the propagator residues $p \pm m$ become twice the mass times idempotents of trace two, and the rate of $e^{+}e^{-} \to \mu^{+}\mu^{-}$ follows from two Clifford traces: \[ \sigma = \frac{4\pi\alpha^{2}}{3s}\,\frac{\beta(3 - \beta^{2})}{2} \]. [[c:synthesis.electron-positron-to-muon-pairs-in-the-spacetime-algebra-lsz-tree-cross-section-and-one-loop-unitarity]]

At the next order, the part of the photon's dressing that corresponds to real pairs being produced equals the tree rate, the s-channel optical-theorem relation for the photon self-energy. [[c:synthesis.electron-positron-to-muon-pairs-in-the-spacetime-algebra-lsz-tree-cross-section-and-one-loop-unitarity]] The rest is the slow growth of the electric force with energy, $(\alpha/(3\pi))(\ln(s/m^{2}) - 5/3)$ at large $s$, and reading that growth as a change of the charge itself, $e = Z_{3}^{1/2}e_{0}$, uses the Krein premise. [[c:synthesis.electron-positron-to-muon-pairs-in-the-spacetime-algebra-lsz-tree-cross-section-and-one-loop-unitarity]]
t:synthesis.electron-positron-to-muon-pa:
Every loop so far has used a borrowed regulator, and the Pauli-Villars one needs fields of negative weight. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-vacuum-polarisation-extends-without-a-regulator-and-ward-preserving-extensions-differ-only-by-the-renormalisation-constants]]

A standard alternative, extending the loop kernels across the points where they are singular, needs none. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-vacuum-polarisation-extends-without-a-regulator-and-ward-preserving-extensions-differ-only-by-the-renormalisation-constants]] Under the imported extension theorem of Epstein and Glaser, the one-loop vacuum polarisation extends to a covariant, transverse kernel with log coefficient of magnitude $e^{2}/(12\pi^{2})$ per Dirac fermion, using no Pauli-Villars field and no Krein form. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-vacuum-polarisation-extends-without-a-regulator-and-ward-preserving-extensions-differ-only-by-the-renormalisation-constants]]

For the other one-loop kernels the result is narrower. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-vacuum-polarisation-extends-without-a-regulator-and-ward-preserving-extensions-differ-only-by-the-renormalisation-constants]] Covariant extensions that keep the Ward identities can differ only by the three constants physicists already adjust, $Z_{3}$, $\delta m$ and $Z_{2} = Z_{1}$, but that such extensions exist is imported, not proved, and the self-energy and vertex still hold under the Krein premise. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-vacuum-polarisation-extends-without-a-regulator-and-ward-preserving-extensions-differ-only-by-the-renormalisation-constants]] The tower's own floors are no substitute, since no smooth weighting of them keeps a boost. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-vacuum-polarisation-extends-without-a-regulator-and-ward-preserving-extensions-differ-only-by-the-renormalisation-constants]]
t:synthesis.one-loop-vacuum-polarisation:
The same extension result makes the axial divergence of the three-current loop independent of the scheme. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-vacuum-polarisation-extends-without-a-regulator-and-ward-preserving-extensions-differ-only-by-the-renormalisation-constants]]

In the spacetime algebra that axial anomaly is the pseudoscalar part of the square of the field bivector, \[ \langle I_{4}F^{2}\rangle_{0} = -2E\cdot B , \] with the textbook strength found by Adler, Bell and Jackiw, recomputed here with imported Pauli-Villars regulators. [[c:synthesis.triangle-anomaly-in-the-spacetime-algebra-is-the-pseudoscalar-part-of-the-field-square-and-cancels-per-generation]]

For one generation of the series' content the anomaly tensor vanishes on the whole gauge algebra, so the cancellation holds generation by generation, whatever their number. [[c:synthesis.triangle-anomaly-in-the-spacetime-algebra-is-the-pseudoscalar-part-of-the-field-square-and-cancels-per-generation]] The mixed gravitational condition is met by a trace count, $\mathrm{tr}\,Y = 0$, not by a computed triangle. [[c:synthesis.triangle-anomaly-in-the-spacetime-algebra-is-the-pseudoscalar-part-of-the-field-square-and-cancels-per-generation]]
t:synthesis.triangle-anomaly-in-the-spac:
Fields that feel a force in only one handedness need more care once the dimension is continued. [[t]]

With $I_4$ as the BMHV chirality element and the unit outside the products, the chiral projectors delete the extra-dimensional part of every loop momentum. [[c:synthesis.chiral-abelian-loops-with-i4-as-the-bmhv-gamma5-need-finite-symmetry-restoring-counterterms]] The calculation then breaks the photon's Ward identities by small, definite amounts, removed by finite counterterms equal to the published ones, \[ \frac{1}{16\pi^{2}}\Big[-\frac{e^{2}}{6}\sum Y^{2}\,\bar A\cdot\bar\partial^{2}\bar A + \frac{e^{4}}{12}\sum Y^{4}(\bar A^{2})^{2}\Big] \]. [[c:synthesis.chiral-abelian-loops-with-i4-as-the-bmhv-gamma5-need-finite-symmetry-restoring-counterterms]]

Unlike the anomaly, in the purely chiral formulation these terms never cancel between fields. [[c:synthesis.chiral-abelian-loops-with-i4-as-the-bmhv-gamma5-need-finite-symmetry-restoring-counterterms]]
t:synthesis.chiral-abelian-loops-with-i4:
The Krein premise has carried much of this, so it is worth asking how much of it the algebra itself supplies. [[t]]

On the conformal spinors the adjoint of the twistor form is Clifford conjugation, and its trace form on vectors is minus the metric, $\tau(a^{\sharp}b) = -a\cdot b$, as in every Clifford algebra. [[c:synthesis.clifford-conjugation-is-the-twistor-adjoint-and-its-trace-form-is-the-one-particle-gupta-bleuler-form]] On polarisations this is exactly the one-particle Gupta-Bleuler form of the premise, unique up to a real factor among Lorentz-invariant forms, and its Fock space is the Feynman-gauge realisation. [[c:synthesis.clifford-conjugation-is-the-twistor-adjoint-and-its-trace-form-is-the-one-particle-gupta-bleuler-form]]

So the form is restated inside the store, not derived: nothing here shows that the unphysical modes must carry the indefinite form, and the premise's other clauses do not follow. [[c:synthesis.clifford-conjugation-is-the-twistor-adjoint-and-its-trace-form-is-the-one-particle-gupta-bleuler-form]]
t:synthesis.clifford-conjugation-is-the-:
The gluons and the weak bosons need the same covariant treatment, now for fields that act on one another. [[t]]

On the derived gauge algebra $\mathfrak{su}(2) \oplus \mathfrak{su}(3) \oplus \mathfrak{u}(1)$, realised by bivectors, the BRST differential \[ sA = \nabla c + g[A, c] , \qquad sc = -\tfrac{g}{2}[c, c] \] squares to zero on every field and derivative for every coupling $g$. [[c:synthesis.field-level-brst-differential-of-the-derived-gauge-fields-is-nilpotent]] It fails if the Jacobi identity, the factor of one half or the covariant term is altered. [[c:synthesis.field-level-brst-differential-of-the-derived-gauge-fields-is-nilpotent]]

The unit $I_4$ never enters and no inner product is needed, so this part of the gauge structure is independent of the Krein premise. [[c:synthesis.field-level-brst-differential-of-the-derived-gauge-fields-is-nilpotent]]
t:synthesis.field-level-brst-differentia:
Positivity of the physical states is where the inner product returns. [[t]]

Under the first two clauses of the Krein premise, the Gupta-Bleuler form and the ghost pairing, the free BRST charge of the gluons and of the massive W and Z in the Feynman-'t Hooft gauge has an explicit homotopy, $Q_{B}R + RQ_{B} = N_{q}$, that counts the unphysical quanta. [[c:synthesis.quartet-homotopy-makes-gluon-and-massive-vector-physical-states-positive-at-every-number-of-quanta]] So at every number of quanta the physical states are the transverse polarisations, two per gluon and three per massive vector, and they have positive length. [[c:synthesis.quartet-homotopy-makes-gluon-and-massive-vector-physical-states-positive-at-every-number-of-quanta]]

The statement is for free fields and is perturbative; the interacting case still rests on Kugo and Ojima's hypotheses. [[c:synthesis.quartet-homotopy-makes-gluon-and-massive-vector-physical-states-positive-at-every-number-of-quanta]]
t:synthesis.quartet-homotopy-makes-gluon:
Beyond perturbation theory, fixing a gauge for a non-abelian field is not unique. [[c:synthesis.non-abelian-gauge-fixing-has-gribov-copies-and-the-weak-rotor-lattice-with-doublets-has-a-perimeter-law]]

In the rotors of the weak factor, some families of equivalent fields meet the Coulomb and Landau conditions more than once, and on a lattice the copies cancel in a signed count equal to the Euler characteristic, zero; so BRST under the Krein premise is a perturbative tool. [[c:synthesis.non-abelian-gauge-fixing-has-gribov-copies-and-the-weak-rotor-lattice-with-doublets-has-a-perimeter-law]] The gauge-invariant lattice needs neither the indefinite form nor ghosts. [[c:synthesis.non-abelian-gauge-fixing-has-gribov-copies-and-the-weak-rotor-lattice-with-doublets-has-a-perimeter-law]]

With a frozen doublet the weak Wilson loop at infinite coupling follows a perimeter law, $c(\kappa)^{P}$, so with the series' two doublets, taken as input, the strong-coupling area law of the weak factor is no test of confinement. [[c:synthesis.non-abelian-gauge-fixing-has-gribov-copies-and-the-weak-rotor-lattice-with-doublets-has-a-perimeter-law]]
t:synthesis.non-abelian-gauge-fixing-has:
The last structural question is why matter fields obey the exclusion rule and force fields do not. [[t]]

For the attached free fields, given the massless two-point function and positive norm, locality decides it: the polarisation sums have degree $2s$, so the tower's anticommuting modes carry only local spinor fields and the palatial commuting modes only local scalar and photon fields. [[c:synthesis.locality-of-the-attached-free-fields-fixes-their-statistics]] An elementary Higgs field of positive norm must therefore be palatial, while with an indefinite form an anticommuting scalar can be local, as ghosts are. [[c:synthesis.locality-of-the-attached-free-fields-fixes-their-statistics]]
t:synthesis.locality-of-the-attached-fre:
Interactions could in principle spoil that tie. [[t]]

If the interacting fields are built by causal perturbation theory from the attached free fields, every interaction term of the series contains matter fields and ghosts in pairs. [[c:synthesis.interacting-fields-of-causal-perturbation-theory-keep-the-spin-statistics-connection-at-even-ghost-number]] Then the grading equals the full turn $U(2\pi)$ to every order on fields of even ghost count, in particular at ghost number zero, and the Jost import is needed only beyond perturbation theory. [[c:synthesis.interacting-fields-of-causal-perturbation-theory-keep-the-spin-statistics-connection-at-even-ghost-number]]
t:synthesis.interacting-fields-of-causal:
Beyond perturbation theory one route goes through the vacuum's own symmetries restricted to wedge-shaped regions. [[t]]

In the spacetime algebra the reflection of a wedge is conjugation by a single element, its boost bivector $B$, and the reflections of a wedge and its quarter-turned copy compose to a rotor of square $-1$, the $2\pi$ rotation in the spin group. [[c:synthesis.wedge-reflections-compose-to-the-two-pi-rotor-so-geometric-modular-conjugations-give-interacting-spin-statistics]] So under the spectrum condition, if the vacuum's modular conjugations act geometrically on wedges, Kuckert's theorem gives spin-statistics for interacting fields. [[c:synthesis.wedge-reflections-compose-to-the-two-pi-rotor-so-geometric-modular-conjugations-give-interacting-spin-statistics]]

Nothing in the store supplies that action on the local algebras, so this route remains conditional. [[c:synthesis.wedge-reflections-compose-to-the-two-pi-rotor-so-geometric-modular-conjugations-give-interacting-spin-statistics]]
conclusion:
Along the trail the tower's modes are attached to spacetime through the conformal spinor space and quantised with the spacetime volume element as the field's unit, and the field theory built on them reproduces standard electrodynamics through the second correction, a scattering rate and the cancellation of the anomaly, each in a stated scheme. [[t]]

Most of the loop results hold under one adopted premise, the indefinite Krein form for gauge fields, whose one-particle form the algebra restates as the trace form of Clifford conjugation without deriving it. [[c:synthesis.clifford-conjugation-is-the-twistor-adjoint-and-its-trace-form-is-the-one-particle-gupta-bleuler-form]]

Four matters remain open. [[t]]

Renormalisation in a regulator-free scheme stops at the vacuum polarisation: that Ward-preserving extensions exist for the other one-loop kernels is imported, not proved. [[c:synthesis.one-loop-vacuum-polarisation-extends-without-a-regulator-and-ward-preserving-extensions-differ-only-by-the-renormalisation-constants]] The second-order result still uses dimensional regularisation, a borrowed method. [[c:synthesis.two-loop-qed-in-the-spacetime-algebra-continued-in-dimension-gives-the-second-beta-coefficient]]

The interacting gauge fields are not yet built: quartet positivity holds for free fields, and the interacting case rests on Kugo and Ojima's hypotheses. [[c:synthesis.quartet-homotopy-makes-gluon-and-massive-vector-physical-states-positive-at-every-number-of-quanta]] Confinement of pure colour, the mass-gap question, is not addressed. [[c:synthesis.non-abelian-gauge-fixing-has-gribov-copies-and-the-weak-rotor-lattice-with-doublets-has-a-perimeter-law]]

Spin-statistics for interacting fields beyond perturbation theory waits on a modular action that the store does not supply. [[c:synthesis.wedge-reflections-compose-to-the-two-pi-rotor-so-geometric-modular-conjugations-give-interacting-spin-statistics]]
